Wedding cakes in Dubai

We bake wedding cakes in Dubai for couples who want a cake that tastes as good as it looks. Every cake is designed with you, baked fresh two days before the wedding and finished by hand in our kitchen in Al Quoz.

Wedding cake flavours

Choose up to three flavours, one for each tier. Most couples mix one classic flavour with one that tells their own story.

Classic vanilla

Madagascan vanilla sponge with vanilla bean buttercream. Light, soft and loved by guests of every age.

Pistachio and rose

Our most requested flavour in Dubai: pistachio sponge, rose syrup and a white chocolate ganache.

Hand-made sugar flowers

Every petal is shaped by hand and coloured to match your bouquet.

Wedding cake prices

Prices depend on the number of guests, the number of tiers and how much hand-made sugar work you want. We send a written quote within one working day after your tasting.

How far in advance should I order my wedding cake?

Book three to six months before the wedding. In the busy winter season, dates fill up quickly, so a deposit holds your date.

Delivery across Dubai

We deliver and set up the cake at your venue anywhere in Dubai. Our team checks the table, the temperature and the flowers before we leave.

Book a tasting

Tastings are free for couples who book with us. You try six flavours and talk through the design with our head baker. Book your tasting or read our planner's tips.
